messages:
marcel: quick heads-up from the design pass on the small help ribbon we show on Routes. found a few cross-link + copy + a11y things worth fixing before the patch release.
ivy: list 'em out, concise please.
marcel: 1) Lexicon mismatch: ribbon labels use 'Capacity' and the docs mostly say 'Provisioned capacity'. Support tickets show both. proposal: canonicalize to 'Capacity' in UI and add a one-line alias in docs ("formerly: provisioned capacity").
harper: +1 to shorter UI term. i'll do a quick docs sweep for aliases.
marcel: 2) Anchor behavior: the tiny link icon currently opens the doc but doesn't scroll to the relevant heading. users expect to land at the examples block. we should add stable anchors and have the icon open with the anchor (#routing-examples). micro-interaction: show a subtle toast "Opening docs at Examples" when navigating.
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened issue #930 to add anchors and stable ids for examples, routing-policy, and batching-hints. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/issues/930
a11y: accessibility note: the link icon must be focusable (tabindex=0), have aria-label="Open docs: Routing examples", and when landing on the anchored heading include a visually-hidden summary so screen readers get context.
marcel: 3) CTA wording: ribbon has both "Docs" button and an inline "Learn more" link. both feel passive. suggestion: primary button -> "Open docs", inline -> context-aware like "See routing examples" for cards that point to examples.
ivy: agree. also on narrow screens collapse to a single overflow menu so we don't crowd the ribbon.
harper: added: on mobile the ribbon will show a kebab with "Open docs" and "Examples" entries.
marcel: 4) Focus & escape behavior: when the help panel opens, focus must move to the panel heading and ESC should close reliably across browsers. i repro'd inconsistent ESC on Firefox. add a focus-return on close to the trigger.
a11y: also request aria-live="polite" announcement when the panel opens: "Help panel opened: Routing". and role="dialog" for proper semantics.
marcel: 5) Microcopy: a couple tiny lines in examples use passive voice: "Requests may be routed" -> prefer "We route requests" or even better context-specific active lines. small copy sweep will help.
harper: i'll prepare a PR with phrasing changes + mapping file (UI term -> docs term -> canonical term).
docs-bot: docs-bot: PR #742 created to add anchors + glossary alias and start canonical mapping. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/742
ivy: timeline: harper will post the copy + mapping by EOD; a11y will run a 10-min checklist after PR lands; marcel to slot the dev task in next sprint.
marcel: thanks all. small ask: when you open the doc at an anchor, let's avoid full-page context shifts on mobile (smooth scroll preferred). tag this thread when PR #742 is ready for review. :raised_hands:
thread_summary: Design review for Routes help ribbon: canonicalize 'Capacity' vs 'Provisioned capacity', add stable anchors so link icon opens to Examples, make link icon keyboard-focusable with aria-label and SR summary at destination, change CTAs to action-first copy and collapse extras into an overflow on mobile, ensure focus moves into panel and ESC works cross-browser with aria-live announcement, microcopy sweep, and mapping file. docs-bot referenced issue and PR.
